m: 1. वट् (prob. invented to serve as a root for the words below; cf. √ 1. वृत्) cl. 1. P., वटति (pf. ववाट &c.), to surround, encompass, Dhātup. ix, 13; cl. 10. P. वटयति, to tie, string, connect, xxxv, 5; to divide, partition, xxxv, 65; to speak, xix, 17: Pass. वट्यते (only वट्यन्ते, Viṣṇ. xliii, 34), to be crushed or pounded or ground down.

a: वट् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (वटति) To surround. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (वटयति-ते) 1 To tell. --2 To divide, partition. --3 To surround, encompass. --4 To tie, string, connect. --Caus. (वटयति) To speak.

“DyAyennIlAdrikAntaM SaSiSakalaDaraM muRqamAlaM maheSaM digvastraM piNgakeSaM qamarumaTa sfRiM KaqgaSUlABayAni । nAgaM GaRwAM kapAlaM karasarasiruhErvviBrataM BImadaMzwraM sarpAkalpaM trinetraM kftyABUtagadApaham ॥” 3 ॥ evaM DyAtvA mAnasEH saMpUjya SaNKasTApanaM kuryyAt ॥ * ॥ asya pUjAyantram । “DarmmADarmmAdiBiH kxptapIWe paNkajaSoBite । zawkoRAntastrikoRasTe vyomapaNkajasaMyute ॥” tato kapAlI BIzaRaScEva saMhAro'zwO ca BEravAH ॥” etErazwaBEravErdvitIyAvaraRam । tataH zawkoRezu hrAM vAM hfdayAya nama ityanena pUjayet । tataH pUrvvAdiqAkinIrAkiRIlAkinIkAkinIsAkinIhAkinImAlinIputtrAn devIputtrAn umAputtrAn rudraputtrAn mAtfkAputtrAn dakziRe yajet । UrdDve UrdDvamuKIputtrAn aDo'DomuKIputtrAn । tadbahirazwapatrezu lokeSAn vawukarUpAn pUjayet । tadbahiH pUrvve o~ brahmARIputtrAya nibanDe । “brahmARIputtrakaM pUrvve mAheSIputtramESvare । vEzRavIputtrakaM sOmye kOmArIputtramAnile ॥ indrARIputtrakaM BUyaH paScime pUjayettataH । mahAlakzmIsutaM paYcAdrakzodiSi samarccayet । vArAhIputtrakaM yAmye cAmuRqAputtramAnale ॥” tadbahirddaSadikzu ca । hetukaM tripurAntakaM vetAlaM vahrijihvaM karAlaM kAlAntakaM ekapAdaM BImarUpaM acalaM cAwakeSvaraM pUjayet । tato yoginIsahitadivyayogISAya namaH । evaM yoginIsahitAntarIkzayogISAya namaH । evaM yoginIsahitaBUmizWayogISAya namaH । ISAnAgninirftizu pUjayet ॥ * ॥ asya puraScaraRamekaviMSatilakzajapaH । “varRalakzaM japenmantraM havizyASI jitendriyaH । taddaSAMSaM prajuhuyAttilErmaDurasaMyutEH ॥” * ॥ aTa validAnam । “pUrvvaM viGnaM durgAM samArADya valiM dadyAt । SAlyannaM palalaM sarpirlAjacUrRAni SarkarAH ॥ guqamikzurasApUpErmaDvaktEH parimiSritEH । kftvA kavalamArADya devaM prAguktavartmanA । raktacandanapuzpAdyErniSi tasmE valiM haret ॥” yadvA । “anyUnANgamajaM hatvA rAjasaM prAgudIritam । valipradAnasamaye ripURAM sarvvasEnyakam । nivedayedvalitvena vawukAya viSizwaDIH ॥ vidarBayecCatrunAmnA valimantraM taTA suDIH । Satrupakzasya ruDiraM piSitaYca dine dine ॥ Bakzayasva gaREH sArdDaM sArameyasamanvitaH । valimantro'yamAKyAtaH sarvvezAM vijayapradaH ॥ anena valinA hfzwo vawukaH parasEnyakam । sarvvaM gaReByo viBajeccAmiza krudDamAnasaH ॥ evaM kfte parabalaM kzIyate nAtra saMSayaH ॥” iti tantrasAraH ॥ * ॥ aTa vawukaBEravastotram । “kElAsaSiKarAsInaM devadevaM jagadgurum । SaNkaraM paripapracCa pArvvatI parameSvaram ॥ SrIpArvvatyuvAca । Bagavan sarvvaDarmmajYa sarvvaSAstrAgamAdizu । ApadudDAraRaM mantraM sarvvasidDipradaM nfRAm ॥ sarvvezAYcEva BUtAnAM hitArTaM vAYCitaM mayA । viSezatastu rAjYAM vE SAntipuzwiprasADanam ॥ aNganyAsakaranyAsabIjanyAsasamanvitam । vaktumarhasi deveSa mama harzavivardDanam ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । SfRu devi mahAmantramApadudDArahetukam । sarvvaduHKapraSamanaM sarvvaSatrunivarhaRam ॥ apasmArAdirogARAM jvarAdInAM viSezataH । nASanaM smftimAtreRa mantrarAjamimaM priye ॥ graharAjaBayAnAYca nASanaM suKavardDanam । snehAdbakzyAmi te mantraM sarvvasAramimaM priye ॥ sarvvakAmArTadaM mantraM rAjyaBogapradaM nfRAm । praRavaM pUrvvamuccAryya devI praRavamudDaret ॥ vawukAyeti vE paScAdApadudDAraRAya ca । kurudvayaM tataH paScAdvawukAya punaH kzipet ॥ devI praRavamudDftya mantrarAjamimaM priye । mantrodDAramimaM devi trElokyasyApi durlaBam । aprakASyamimaM mantraM sarvvaSaktisamanvitam ॥ smaraRAdeva mantrasya BUtapretapiSAcakAH । vidravanti BayArttA vE kAlarudrAdiva prajAH ॥ paWedvA pAWayedvApi pUjayedvApi pustakam । nAgnicOraBayaM vApi graharAjaBayantaTA । na ca mArIBayaM tasya sarvvatra suKavAn Bavet ॥ AyurArogyamESvaryyaM puttrapOttrAdisampadaH । Bavanti satataM tasya pustakasyApi pUjanAt ॥ SrIpArvvatyuvAca । ya eza BEravo nAma ApadudDArako mataH । tvayA ca kaTito deva BEravaH kalpa uttamaH ॥ tasya nAmasahasrARi ayutAnyarvvudAni ca । sAramudDftya tezAM vE nAmAzwaSatakaM vada ॥ * ॥ SrIBagavAnuvAca । yastu saMkIrttayedetat sarvvaduzwanivarhaRam । sarvvAn kAmAnavApnoti sADakaH sidDimeva ca ॥ SfRu devi pravakzyAmi BEravasya mahAtmanaH । ApadudDArakasyeha nAmAzwaSatamuttamam ॥ sarvvapApaharaM puRyaM sarvvApadbinivArakam । sarvvakAmArTadaM devi sADakAnAM suKAvaham ॥ dehANganyasanaYcEva pUrvvaM kuryyAt samAhitaH । BEravaM mUrdDni vinyasya lalAwe BImadarSanam ॥ akzRorBUtASrayaM nyasya vadane tIkzRadarSanam । kzetrapaM karRayormaDye kzetrapAlaM hfdi nyaset ॥ kzetrAKyaM nABideSe ca kawyAM sarvvAGanASanam । trinetramUrvvorvinyasya jaNGayo raktapARikam ॥ pAdayordevadeveSaM sarvvANge vawukaM nyaset । evaM nyAsaviDiM kftvA tadanantaramuttamam ॥ nAmAzwaSatakasyApi Cando'nuzwubudAhftam । bfhadAraRyako nAma fziSca parikIrttitaH ॥ devatA kaTitA ceha sadBirvawukaBEravaH । DarmmArTakAmamokzezu viniyogaH prakIrttitaH ॥ * ॥ o~BEravo BUtanATaSca BUtAtmA BUtaBAvanaH । kzetradaH kzetrapAlaSca kzetrajYaH kzattriyo virAw । SmaSAnavAsI mAMsASI KarparASI SAntidaH SudDaH SaNkarapriyabAnDavaH । azwamUrttirniDISaSca jYAnacakzustamomayaH ॥ azwADAraH kalADAraH sarpayuktaH SaSISiKaH । BUDaro BUDarADISo BUpatirBUDarAtmakaH ॥ kaNkAlaDArI muRqI ca ॥ satkulInAya SAntAya fjave damBavarjjite । dadyAt stotramidaM puRyaM sarvvakAmaPalapradam । DyAnaM vakzyAmi devasya yaTA DyAtvA paWennaraH ॥ * o~ SudDasPawikasaNkASaM sahasrAdityavarccasam । BEravaH pAtu lalAwaM BIzaRastaTA । netre ca BUtahananaH sArameyAnugo BruvO ॥ BUtanATaSca me karRO kapolO pretavAhanaH । nAsApuwO taTozWO ca BasmANgaH sarvvaBUzaRaH ॥ BIzaRAsyo mamAsyaYca Saktihasto
